literal: of the land by the nature water having changed like that it will become to people of the company that which has the nature will become knowledge
translation: Water changes and takes on the nature of the soil it flows through. Likewise, the mindset of people takes on the nature of the company they keep.
modern: நிலத்தின் தன்மைக்கு ஏற்ப நீர் தன் குணம் மாறி அந்த நிலத்தின் தன்மையை அடையும். அதுபோலவே, மனிதர்களின் அறிவும் அவர்கள் சேர்ந்திருக்கும் கூட்டத்தின் தன்மைக்கு ஏற்ப மாறும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a simple natural analogy to explain how human character is shaped by association. Rainwater is naturally pure, but when it flows over soil, it absorbs the soil's color, taste, and qualities. Similarly, a person's natural intelligence and mindset ('அறிவு') are inevitably altered by the people they choose to associate with ('இனம்'). Therefore, one's character ultimately reflects the nature of their companions.
